description: On the tabletop in front of you, there’s a blue-and-yellow toothbrush lying near the center. The left hand stays planted on the toothbrush to steady it as a left-hand object, while the right hand moves in from the right, pinches and pulls a blue rubber band/loop off the toothbrush, then lifts it to the right so it becomes a right-hand object while the toothbrush remains under the left hand.
